phases.goal: Open the productivity folder, then open Clock inside it.
Press Home to exit the current app and return to the Home Screen.
Close the currently open folder.
Open the media folder.
Open YouTube inside the current folder.
Press Home to exit the current app and return to the Home Screen.
Close the currently open folder.
Open Contacts from the Home Screen, then enter "Operator Jane Doe 27" into the Search search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Open Shortcuts from the Home Screen and open Library (All Shortcuts). Do not run a shortcut.
Open Gallery in Shortcuts. Do not run or add a shortcut.
Open Calendar from the Home Screen, then enter "Operator coffee — 11/11, 8:30 pm" into the Search search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Close the current document preview.
Enter "Operator_draft-27.txt" in the visible Search field.
Open App Store from the Home Screen, then enter "focus timer" into the Games, Apps, Stories, and More search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Open Reminders from the Home Screen, then enter "Operator groceries: tea & oat milk" into the Search search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Open Location List.
Open Weather. If a city forecast is showing, open Location List first. Then enter the supplied city São Paulo in the city search field. Do not add a city.
Open Books from the Home Screen, then enter "The Little Prince" into the Apple Books search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Open Settings from the Home Screen, then enter "Reduce Motion" into the Search search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Open YouTube from the Home Screen, then enter "quiet keyboard ASMR" into the Search YouTube search field. Open search first if the field is not visible.
Open TikTok from the Home Screen.
Open TikTok from the Home Screen.
Tap Skip ad.
